source: ICS 630-01, Foreign Language Transliteration Standards, Annex D: Standards for the Transliteration of Chinese Personal Names in Written Reports and Products (effective 10 August 2015)

cover_memo.extraction_method: single scanned page, no text layer; transcribed from a 200 dpi render (visual read)
cover_memo.title: Foreign Language Transliteration Standards
cover_memo.authority: National Security Act of 1947, as amended; the Reform and Terrorism Prevention Act of 2004; Executive Order 12333, as amended; and IC Directive Number 607, Intelligence Community Foreign Language Capability
cover_memo.policy: Standardized transliteration within the IC on all finished analytical reports and products. Foreign Language Transliteration Standards (FLTS) for individual languages are developed and reviewed by each IC element's Senior Language Authority (SLA), promulgated as annexes titled 'Standards for the Transliteration of Personal Names in Written Reports and Products'.
cover_memo.approval: ADNI, through the Foreign Language Program Office (FLPO), and approved IC FLTS are issued as ICS 630-01; Heads of IC elements review and approve ICS 630-01 within their respective IC element
cover_memo.effective: 10 August 2015 (date of signature, Deana A. Krichter, ADNI for Human Capital)
